This gives the required lower bound. 5 Summary and Future Work In this paper we considered quantum algorithms dealing with classical probability distributions. We identified four different models, and proved various relations between them. We conjecture that models (i), (ii) and (iv) are equivalent. Also, we considered the problem of distinguishing two probability distributions and obtained precise characterisation of its quantum query complexity in all four models in terms of Hellinger distance between the probability distributions. The complexity turned out to be exactly quadratically smaller than the classical complexity of this problem for all pairs of distributions. We showed that the corresponding algorithm can be implemented efficiently given that the probability distributions p and q can be handled efficiently. We also compared our algorithm with a more standard approach using rejection sampling and amplitude estimation.
